skills.name: award-level-visual-design
skills.description: Landing pages, marketing surfaces and app shell visuals.
skills.body:
# Award-level visual design

Produce interfaces that could sit next to work from leading studios and award winners. Copy patterns, never surfaces.

### Default path: existing system first

- Preserve established patterns, structure, tokens and visual language.
- Extend shared components before introducing parallel chrome.
- For greenfield work, establish the starting design contract.

steps.command: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:pack
